clm.raw_layer_xml_snippet:
<ns0:Layer xmlns:ns0="http://www.opengis.net/wms" xmlns:ns1="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" queryable="1" opaque="0">
        <ns0:Name>msg_fes:clm</ns0:Name>
        <ns0:Title>Cloud Mask - MSG - 0 degree</ns0:Title>
        <ns0:Abstract>The Cloud Mask product describes the scene type (either 'clear' or 'cloudy') on a pixel level. Each pixel is classified as one of the following four types: clear sky over water, clear sky over land, cloud, or not processed (off Earth disc). Applications & Uses: The main use is in support of Nowcasting applications, where it frequently serves as a basis for other cloud products, and the remote sensing of continental and ocean surfaces.</ns0:Abstract>
        <ns0:KeywordList>
          <ns0:Keyword>msg_fes_clm</ns0:Keyword>
          <ns0:Keyword>WCS</ns0:Keyword>
          <ns0:Keyword>ImageMosaic</ns0:Keyword>
        </ns0:KeywordList>
        <ns0:CRS>EPSG:4326</ns0:CRS>
        <ns0:CRS>CRS:84</ns0:CRS>
        <ns0:EX_GeographicBoundingBox>
          <ns0:westBoundLongitude>-77.0</ns0:westBoundLongitude>
          <ns0:eastBoundLongitude>77.0</ns0:eastBoundLongitude>
          <ns0:southBoundLatitude>-77.0</ns0:southBoundLatitude>
          <ns0:northBoundLatitude>77.0</ns0:northBoundLatitude>
        </ns0:EX_GeographicBoundingBox>
        <ns0:BoundingBox CRS="CRS:84" minx="-77.0" miny="-77.0" maxx="77.0" maxy="77.0" />
        <ns0:BoundingBox CRS="EPSG:4326" minx="-77.0" miny="-77.0" maxx="77.0" maxy="77.0" />
        <ns0:Dimension name="time" default="2026-09-19T12:15:00Z" units="ISO8601" nearestValue="1">2020-09-01T00:00:00.000Z/2026-09-19T12:15:00.000Z/PT15M</ns0:Dimension>
        <ns0:Style>
          <ns0:Name>msg_clm</ns0:Name>
          <ns0:Title>RGB with custom legend for msg_clm</ns0:Title>
          <ns0:LegendURL width="640" height="80">
            <ns0:Format>image/png</ns0:Format>
            <ns0:OnlineResource ns1:type="simple" ns1:href="https://view.eumetsat.int/geoserver/ows?service=WMS&version=1.3.0&request=GetLegendGraphic&format=image%2Fpng&width=640&height=80&layer=msg_fes%3Aclm" />
          </ns0:LegendURL>
        </ns0:Style>
      </ns0:Layer>

ir105.raw_layer_xml_snippet:
<ns0:Layer xmlns:ns0="http://www.opengis.net/wms" xmlns:ns1="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" queryable="1" opaque="0">
        <ns0:Name>mtg_fd:ir105_hrfi</ns0:Name>
        <ns0:Title>FCI HRFI IR10.5 μm Image - MTG-I - 0 degree</ns0:Title>
        <ns0:Abstract>Rectified (level 1c) Meteosat FCI full disk image data in high spatial resolution (1km). Level 1c image data corresponds to the geolocated and radiometrically pre-processed image data, ready for further processing, e.g. the extraction of meteorological products. Any spacecraft-specific effects have been removed, and in particular, linearisation and equalisation of the image radiometry have been performed for all FCI channels. The onboard blackbody data has been processed. Both radiometric and geometric quality control information is included.</ns0:Abstract>
        <ns0:KeywordList>
          <ns0:Keyword>mtg_fd_ir105_hrfi</ns0:Keyword>
          <ns0:Keyword>WCS</ns0:Keyword>
          <ns0:Keyword>ImageMosaic</ns0:Keyword>
        </ns0:KeywordList>
        <ns0:CRS>EPSG:4326</ns0:CRS>
        <ns0:CRS>CRS:84</ns0:CRS>
        <ns0:EX_GeographicBoundingBox>
          <ns0:westBoundLongitude>-70.0</ns0:westBoundLongitude>
          <ns0:eastBoundLongitude>70.0</ns0:eastBoundLongitude>
          <ns0:southBoundLatitude>-70.0</ns0:southBoundLatitude>
          <ns0:northBoundLatitude>70.0</ns0:northBoundLatitude>
        </ns0:EX_GeographicBoundingBox>
        <ns0:BoundingBox CRS="CRS:84" minx="-70.0" miny="-70.0" maxx="70.0" maxy="70.0" />
        <ns0:BoundingBox CRS="EPSG:4326" minx="-70.0" miny="-70.0" maxx="70.0" maxy="70.0" />
        <ns0:Dimension name="time" default="2026-09-19T12:20:00Z" units="ISO8601" nearestValue="1">2024-09-23T00:00:00.000Z/2026-09-19T12:20:00.000Z/PT10M</ns0:Dimension>

notes: Цель probe — установить, СУЩЕСТВУЕТ ли пригодная пространственно-временная структура внутри облачного массива. Это НЕ вывод о наличии атмосферного фронта.
front_score — равновзвешенная сумма 3 нормированных градиентных полей, ПРОИЗВОЛЬНАЯ формула для первого эксперимента, не финальный алгоритм.

Три независимых факта про время, НЕ сводить в один статус: requested_timestamp (что запросили) / grid_alignment (лежит ли арифметически на сетке) / used_timestamp (что сервер реально подтвердил через Warning-заголовок, если вернул).
control_region_candidates — НЕ подтверждённый negative control: однородность каждого региона не доказана заранее, сравнивать нужно по факту полученных чисел.
global_field_shift — глобальный сдвиг ВСЕГО поля (FFT phase correlation), не движение конкретной front-like структуры.
ir105_decode.ir105_physical_decode_available='partial' — grayscale-style как относительный proxy, не калиброванная температура в Кельвинах.
